refnamediv.refpurpose: Evaluate a polynomial at specified points.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: y = polyval(p, x) [y, delta] = polyval(p, x, S) [y, delta] = polyval(p, x, S, mu)

listitem.para: Coefficients of the polynomial (vector). The coefficients are in descending powers of the polynomial.
Points at which the polynomial is evaluated (vector or matrix).
(optional) Structure generated by `polyfit` for error estimation.
(optional) Centering and scaling parameters [mean, std] for x.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `polyval` function evaluates a polynomial at specified points using its coefficients. It supports error estimation when used with the structure `S` from `polyfit`. If centering and scaling parameters `mu` are provided, the evaluation is performed on scaled values of `x`.
Notes - The function uses Horner's method for efficient polynomial evaluation. - If `S` is provided, `delta` estimates the standard deviation of the error in predicting future observations.
